description: Demo Labs at DEF CON Safe Mode showcases open-source security tools, vulnerability scanners, and testing frameworks demonstrated by their creators.

talks.title: Safe Mode Demo Labs - Jakub Botwicz
talks.teaser: A live demonstration of Cotopaxi, an open-source testing framework for evaluating Internet of Things device protocol security.

talks.title: Safe Mode Demo Labs - Olivier Bilodeau
talks.teaser: A demonstration of PyRDP, a Python tool for Remote Desktop Protocol interception, credential capture, and honeypot deployment.

talks.title: Safe Mode Demo Labs - Viral Maniar
talks.teaser: A demo of Phirautee, an open-source ransomware simulator designed to test endpoint detection and incident response capabilities.

talks.title: Safe Mode Demo Labs - Vincent Rose
talks.teaser: A walkthrough of Starkiller, a graphical user interface frontend for managing PowerShell Empire post-exploitation agents and operations.

talks.title: Safe Mode Demo Labs - Tamoaki Tani - malconfscan with cuckoo
talks.teaser: A demonstration of using MalConfScan with Cuckoo Sandbox to extract configuration data from malware families in memory.

talks.title: Safe Mode Demo Labs - Matthew Creel - redlure
talks.teaser: A demonstration of redlure, an on-premises collaborative phishing framework for managing and executing red team campaigns.

talks.title: Safe Mode Demo Labs - Chris Nevin
talks.teaser: A demonstration of Carnivore, an open-source automated network reconnaissance and target assessment utility.

talks.title: Safe Mode Demo Labs - Ajin Abraham - Mobile App Security Testing with MobSF
talks.teaser: A demonstration of Mobile Security Framework (MobSF) for performing automated static and dynamic security analysis of mobile apps.
